Kasia Nowak: hey team! Kasia here — starting today on Growth. excited to be here. quick Qs: who do I ping for MDM/device pickup, VPN access, and getting added to the growth gsheet? also two fun facts: i make terrible sourdough and i lift weights on weekends :weight_lifter: 
Alex Reyes: welcome Kasia!! :tada: People Ops handles the hardware + swag. @onboard-bot will DM you the pickup options, but i can also check if we have a spare dock. 
onboard-bot: Hi Kasia — welcome to Redwood Inference! I created your onboarding checklist and sent your laptop options via DM. Please reply with preferred delivery or pickup. 
Samir Patel: hey Kasia — i'm on Platform and will be your boot buddy for the week. for VPN, we use the company MVPN. steps are here: https://intra.redwood/dev/vpn-setup (let me know if the link 403s). 
Ivy Chen: for MDM enrollment ping me once you have the machine. i can remote-enroll if you need. also added you to #growth-docs workspace access but you might need the growth gsheet explicitly — @Tom can add that. 
Tom Alvarez: added — sent an invite to your email for the growth content gsheet. if you need production read-only later, file a request in #eng-platform-access and tag me. 
Kasia Nowak: thanks all! i tried the VPN link and it prompted for SSO — got through. one more: is there a recommended Terminal config? i use fish + starship. 
Samir Patel: fish + starship is gold. add this to your ~/.config/fish/config.fish: 

```
# small snippet to set up starship
eval (starship init fish)
set -x PATH $HOME/.local/bin $PATH
```

Kasia Nowak: nice — will do. also — fun fact follow-up: guilty-pleasure snack is spicy seaweed, and i've got a mini-collection of chipped vintage pins if anyone swaps. :sparkles: 
Alex Reyes: love the pins. welcome again — lunch crew tends to meet in #lunch-plans at 12:30. someone will ping you for coffee run. 
Ivy Chen: FYI i've scheduled a quick 1:1 with you tomorrow to walk through MDM and the growth repo access. 15 mins should be enough. 
Kasia Nowak: perfect. appreciate the warm welcome, team. excited to pair on the first ticket later today :nerd_face:
